card.name: Wear duration in transdermal patch labels
card.fires_on: Small words or spaces just before a patch wear time or strength, such as "for" or a blank before "72-hour" or "7-day", in fentanyl and buprenorphine transdermal system labels.

modes.label: Before wear time
modes.description: The space or word "for" right before a number of hours or days of patch wear.
